seedAndPrototypeFlow.purpose: Create a blank Magic Patterns design scaffold returning editorId, artifactId, and editorUrl.
Verify active artifactId and confirm isGenerating is false.
Upload deterministic React + TypeScript + Tailwind seed for SkillsBridgeReviewConsole.
Compile and activate the seeded artifact in Magic Patterns before prompting.

arguments.prompt: Evolve SkillsBridgeReviewConsole using Split Operations Canvas (Two-column master-detail split canvas: left queue with live status segmentation; right sticky inspection & human sign-off drawer so reviewers never lose list context.). Preserve all Northstar design tokens, WCAG AA contrast, and explicit interactive/empty/loading/error states.

seedAndPrototypeFlow.purpose: Trigger creative AI iteration in Magic Patterns on top of the faithful seed.

arguments.title: SkillsBridge — Work-Evidence to HR Skill Attribution Console — 4 Structural UX Directions

files.name: A: Split Operations Canvas
files.description: Two-column master-detail split canvas: left queue with live status segmentation; right sticky inspection & human sign-off drawer so reviewers never lose list context.

files.name: B: Progressive Triage Feed
files.description: Focused single-column progressive disclosure feed with inline expandable evidence cards, keyboard shortcut pills (J/K/A/R), and zero modal interruptions.

files.name: C: High-Density Operations Matrix
files.description: Compact tabular command matrix optimized for high-volume dispatchers: monospace revision hashes, inline SLA badges, and batch idempotent retry bar.

files.name: D: Guided 4-Step Verification Wizard
files.description: Stepped verification rail (1. Evidence Check → 2. Identity & Vocabulary Match → 3. Human Decision → 4. Idempotent Sync Receipt) reducing cognitive load for new reviewers.

baseline.focus: SkillsBridge — Work-Evidence to HR Skill Attribution Console primary triage and human approval surface
